material_seen.content: The 18 request records, their identical supplied instruction, and payloads; inspected through a truncated cat output and Python 3 projections of that same file.
Supplied system, developer, and user instructions, environment context, and the parent agent's Reporter assignment. No other repository files or other agents' work were read.

model_identity.exposed_identity: Codex, described in the session instructions as based on GPT-6

ai_reporting_instrumentation.author: AI language-model Reporter
ai_reporting_instrumentation.composition: Reports composed in ordinary prose by the language model, one attempt per record, without programmatic prose templates or string substitution.
ai_reporting_instrumentation.tools: functions.exec and exec_command; cat and Python 3 for reading and projecting the supplied packet, checking record count and word limits, and serializing the reports and metadata.
ai_reporting_instrumentation.save_policy: Reports saved once; no post-save revision; no commits.

shared_training_limitations: The Reporter is an AI model rather than an independent human measurement channel. Shared training, priors, and model-family behavior with other AI roles may create correlated judgments; no training independence is established by this procedure.
batch_context_and_blinding_limitations: All 18 records were visible within one shared conversation context. The Reporter was told this was a diagnostic batch and received an instruction restricting reads to the request packet. Opaque IDs and supplied content remain visible. Read restrictions and role separation are procedural, not secure or cryptographic blinding; independence from the Controller, hidden classifications, or batch-context influence is not established. No comparison of opaque IDs or inference of experimental variants was used in composing reports.
